title: fix: guard against null financial fields in operation hydration
body:
## Fixes #156 

## Summary
This PR fixes a silent data corruption bug in the operation hydration layer of all four adapter packages and centralises the guard helper in each package's `utils.ts`

## Changes
- Added `requireNumber(value, field, operationId)` to each package's `src/utils.ts`; throws `Error: Invalid operation row <id>: missing required field "<field>"` when a required column is NULL or undefined.
- Replaced all `?? 0` fallbacks in the `preparedData` block of `SendOperationRepository`, `ReceiveOperationRepository` and `MeltOperationRepository` across all four adapters with `requireNumber` calls.
- Added a hydration corruption guard test group to sqlite3 and sqlite-bun contract test files covering NULL financial fields for send, receive, and melt operations

title: Repository hydration masks missing prepared operation amounts
body:
## Problem

The persisted operation repositories currently coerce missing amount fields to `0` when hydrating rows for states that should already have prepared data.

Examples in the pre-v4 number-based adapters:

```ts
fee: row.fee ?? 0,
inputAmount: row.inputAmount ?? 0,
```

and for melt operations:

```ts
amount: row.amount ?? 0,
fee_reserve: row.fee_reserve ?? 0,
swap_fee: row.swap_fee ?? 0,
inputAmount: row.inputAmount ?? 0,
```

This is valid for `init` rows only because those rows have not been prepared yet. For prepared-or-later states, these fields are required by the operation model. Defaulting a missing value to zero can hide corrupted or partially written rows and rehydrate them as plausible operations with incorrect financial data.

## Affected surfaces

- Send operation repositories: `fee`, `inputAmount`
- Receive operation repositories: `fee`
- Melt operation repositories: `amount`, `fee_reserve`, `swap_fee`, `inputAmount`
- Applies across persisted adapters, including SQLite-backed adapters and IndexedDB

## Suggested fix

Keep `init` row hydration permissive for fields that are not expected yet, but fail fast for required fields once the state implies prepared data exists.

For example:

```ts
function requireNumber(value: number | null, field: string, operationId: string): number {
  if (value == null) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid operation row ${operationId}: missing ${field}`);
  }
  return value;
}
```

Then use it only after the state check:

```ts
if (row.state === 'init') {
  return { ...base, state: 'init' };
}

const preparedData = {
  fee: requireNumber(row.fee, 'fee', row.id),
  inputAmount: requireNumber(row.inputAmount, 'inputAmount', row.id),
};
```

## Scope

This is a pre-existing repository invariant issue, not part of the cashu-ts v4 amount migration. Track it separately so the v4 migration does not grow in scope.

title: feat: add reusable onchain mint quotes
body:
## Description

This pull request adds canonical method-aware quote lifecycle support and reusable NUT-30 onchain mint quotes. It makes BOLT11 mint preparation quote-first, adds reusable onchain quote creation and balance-gated withdrawal finalization, and persists canonical mint/melt quote records across the storage adapters.

## Problem

Mint quote state was previously tied to operation-shaped snapshots, which made quote-level observation, reusable address quotes, sibling operation lookup, and adapter persistence ambiguous. NUT-30 onchain minting also needs durable NUT-20 quote keys and canonical quote balance tracking so funded reusable quotes can be claimed safely without double-spending locally executing siblings.

## Summary

- Adds `QuoteApi`, canonical quote lifecycle persistence, method-scoped mint quote data, quote-level `mint-quote:updated` events, and reusable onchain mint handling.
- Adds NUT-20 mint quote key purpose metadata plus deterministic onchain withdrawal preparation/finalization and auto-claim processing for funded reusable quotes.
- Updates SQLite3, SQLite Bun, Expo SQLite, IndexedDB, and memory repositories for canonical mint/melt quotes, legacy quote snapshot migration, and adapter contract coverage.
- Updates docs and integration coverage for quote-first minting and NUT-30 onchain mint flows.
- Compatibility risk: this changes released core APIs/events, persistent adapter schemas, and mint quote protocol behavior; changesets mark the affected packages accordingly.

## Verification

- `bun run --filter='@cashu/coco-core' test:unit`
- `./scripts/test-integration.sh sqlite-bun`

## Changeset

- Added `.changeset/quote-first-bolt11.md` for major quote-first/canonical quote storage changes across core and adapters.
- Added `.changeset/decoupled-mint-quotes.md`, `.changeset/remote-quote-fetch.md`, `.changeset/silver-onchain-claims.md`, `.changeset/smart-quote-watchers.md`, and `.changeset/bright-onchain-mints.md` for follow-up core API/event/onchain behavior updates.

title: feat: add quote-first BOLT11 mint operations
body:
## Description

This pull request adds canonical method-aware mint quote records and makes BOLT11 mint preparation quote-first. Core exposes `ops.mint.createQuote()` and prepares mint operations from an existing canonical quote while keeping the existing amount-based `prepare({ amount })` compatibility wrapper.

## Problem

Mint quotes were stored and observed through operation-shaped snapshots, which made quote reuse, full quote-identity lookup, and quote-level observer events ambiguous. Persistent adapters also needed migrations and contract coverage for canonical quote records before quote-first minting could be used consistently across storage backends.

## Summary

- Adds canonical mint quote models/repositories keyed by normalized `(mintUrl, method, quoteId)` and sibling operation lookup by full quote identity.
- Updates mint operation services, watchers, processors, events, docs, and React hook behavior around canonical quote updates.
- Adds SQLite3, SQLite Bun, Expo SQLite, and IndexedDB persistence support plus schema/contract coverage for quote records and legacy BOLT11 quote snapshot migration.
- Compatibility risk: this changes released core events/public APIs and persistent adapter schemas; changesets mark the affected packages as major.

## Verification

- `bun run --filter='@cashu/coco-core' test:unit`
- `bun run --filter='@cashu/coco-core' typecheck`
- `bun run --filter='@cashu/coco-adapter-tests' build`
- `bun --cwd packages/sqlite3 test src/test/schema.test.ts src/test/contract.test.ts src/test/MintOperationRepository.test.ts`
- `bun --cwd packages/sqlite-bun test src/test/schema.test.ts src/test/contract.test.ts src/test/MintOperationRepository.test.ts`
- `bun --cwd packages/expo-sqlite test src/test/schema.test.ts src/test/contract.test.ts src/test/MintOperationRepository.test.ts`
- `bun run test:browser -- src/test/contract.test.ts src/repositories/MintOperationRepository.test.ts` from `packages/indexeddb` in local Chromium mode
- `bun test src/repositories/MintOperationRepository.test.ts` from `packages/indexeddb`

Package-wide adapter commands were also tried: SQLite3, SQLite Bun, and Expo SQLite stop at `MINT_URL is not set` for integration tests; IndexedDB’s plain Bun runner lacks an IndexedDB API, and `CI=1` browser mode also requires local Firefox/WebKit Playwright binaries that are not installed.

## Changeset

- Added `.changeset/quote-first-bolt11.md` for major releases of core, adapter tests, IndexedDB, Expo SQLite, SQLite3, and SQLite Bun.
- Added `.changeset/decoupled-mint-quotes.md` for the core quote event/API change.
